notes.title: 0.10: English Localization, more skins and optimizations.
notes.content:
This update brings the following improvements:


 English Localization: the game is now available to play in English.
 10 New Skins: unlock new skins as you level up.
 Optimizations: game textures have been optimized to use less space and memory, and we've cleaned up the game code for better performance.
 Offline Mode: the game now works properly without internet connection.


More minigames will be added in the future. Thank you for reading this!

notes.title: 0.9: Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
Multiplayer is now available on Yapori Minigames, you can now play with up to five friends in the same match!
